title: What Does 5 Need?
objective: For any number 5 or less, name how many more are needed to reach 5.
newIdea: Treating distance to 5 as a fact worth knowing directly, not re-derived by counting every time.

teaching.see: How many empty spaces are left?
teaching.break: Count or subitize the empty spaces.
teaching.build: State the complement: 3 needs 2 more to make 5.
teaching.transform: The same 3, described as itself or as 2 away from 5 — same value, benchmark-relative form.

check.prompt: Fill the empty spaces and count all 5.

examples.transfer: 4 needs 1, without a five-frame shown (mental image only).

mastery.evidence: States the complement to 5 for at least 4 of 5 numbers 1-4, without recounting from scratch.
